AccountType
The type of account set for the user.
"Domain User"
"Domain Administrator"
"Local User"
cid
The customer ID.
0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV-WX
DomainUser
Indicates if the user's credentials are part of a domain controller.
"Yes"
"No"
LastLoggedOnHost
The host that was last logged into the system.
"hostname"
LoggedOnHostCount
The number of hosts logged in at _time.
"0"
LogonTime
The last login time by this user in epoch format.
"1538648887.051"
LogonType
Values defined as follows:
INTERACTIVE: The security principal is logging on
interactively.
NETWORK: The security principal is logging on using a
network.
TERMINAL SERVER: The security principal has logged in
using a terminal server.
"Interactive"
monthsincereset
The number of months since this user's password was last reset.
"1"
PasswordLastSet
The last time in epoch format that this user's password in the
system was set.
"1538648887.051"
_time
The host's local time in epoch format.
"1538648887.051"
User
A system username with domain.
"domain\username"
UserIsAdmin
Indicates whether the user account has administrator privileges.
0: User is not an admin
1: User is an admin
UserName
The username of the system.
"username"
UserSid
The user SID associated with this process.
"S-X-XX-X-XXXXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXXXX-
XXXXXXXXXX"
